capabilities.effect: Decode Markdown frontmatter and body as declared concepts with stable identifiers, annotations, aliases, and publication intent.
capabilities.rationale: Markdown and YAML decoding are already canonical data services; the semiotic mapping is now a pure downstream projection rather than a private reader or filesystem scan.

modernEvidence.effect: Projects canonical Markdown documents into declared concept carriers and admits their universe without file-system ownership.

capabilities.effect: Carry concept declarations, aliases, annotation failures, resolved and unresolved references, provenance, and deterministic changes between two universe cuts.
capabilities.rationale: The useful semantic carrier is immutable declared data. The legacy evaluator's claimed closure and scoring were not implemented; its mutable models and serializers do not survive as a second semantic engine.

modernEvidence.effect: Admits an immutable SignCell, derives identity classes and reference diagnostics, selects publication records, and differentiates universe cuts.

capabilities.effect: Select publishable concepts and project them as escaped single or multi-page static HTML artifacts.
capabilities.rationale: Publication is a system-level projection: VICTOR owns artifact combination, output, conformance, and release manifests, while the new projector owns only this concept view.

modernEvidence.effect: Contributes a single HTML view plus selected index and concept page artifacts through VICTOR's existing projector contract.

capabilities.effect: Observe repository state as contextual evidence without making a concept universe or cache depend on a private fingerprint.
capabilities.rationale: Repository observation is an independent version-control concern; it is not part of Markdown decoding, concept identity, or publication.

modernEvidence.effect: Observes a repository's root, branch, head, and working state as a separate read-only carrier.

capabilities.effect: Provide a runnable package boundary, local configuration, cache, and command-line workflow around the old private implementation.
capabilities.rationale: No independent capability remains after the data and static-publishing carriers are established. A second CLI, cache, configuration language, and package boundary would recreate the scattered downstream system the migration removes.

modernEvidence.effect: Records the retired apparatus and names the existing owners of source parsing, semantic data, repository observation, artifacts, and release.

capabilities.effect: Preserve the scientific discussion of semiotics while accurately recording which historical publishing claims were exploratory rather than executable.
capabilities.rationale: Abstract semiotics remains in the science corpus with its exploratory status. The implementation boundary and retirement decision are engineering practice, not a system feature or a Markdown parser responsibility.

modernEvidence.effect: Separates demonstrated implementation from the old aspirational publisher specification.
Retains semiotic theory while marking publisher-specific passages as historical and exploratory.

capabilities.effect: Demonstrate concept admission, identity resolution, unresolved-reference visibility, publication selection, and HTML projection.
capabilities.rationale: The old tests only exercised the retired Python application. The replacement verifies retained effects at the new carrier boundaries instead of preserving a duplicate runtime.

modernEvidence.effect: Verifies identity, provenance, reference diagnostics, publication selection, and universe differentiation.
Verifies Markdown declaration decoding and SignCell admission.
